question_cn: 白方有a兵，象却是h1格的白格象。黑王能守住a8角。这个局面的结果是：
question_en: White has an a-pawn and a light-squared bishop. Black king holds the a8 corner. The result is:

options.text_cn: 白方必胜，兵一定能升变
options.text_en: White wins, the pawn will promote

options.text_cn: 和局，黑王守住角格即可
options.text_en: Draw, Black king holds the corner

options.text_cn: 白方只要王靠近就能赢
options.text_en: White wins by bringing the king close

explanation_cn: 错色象 + 边路兵 = 和局。升变格(a8)是黑格，白格象无法将死躲在角格的黑王。这是残局中最重要的和局识别模式之一。
explanation_en: Wrong-colored bishop + rook pawn = draw. The promotion square (a8) is dark, so the light-squared bishop can't mate the king in the corner.
